mapper.sql: SELECT c.id AS target_id, c.issued_at, co.title, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS description, i.name AS issuer_name, CAST(NULL AS UUID) AS image_file_id, c.vc_hash AS content_hash FROM tb_credentials c JOIN tb_credential_groups g ON g.id = c.credential_group_id JOIN tb_completions cp ON cp.id = g.completion_id JOIN tb_enrollments e ON e.id = cp.enrollment_id JOIN tb_courses co ON co.id = e.course_id JOIN tb_institutions i ON i.id = co.institution_id

SELECT b.id AS target_id, b.issued_at, CASE WHEN lv.level_name IS NULL THEN COALESCE(d.name, b.badge_name) ELSE COALESCE(d.name, b.badge_name) || ' ' || lv.level_name END AS title, d.description, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS issuer_name, COALESCE(lv.image_file_id, d.image_file_id) AS image_file_id, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS content_hash FROM tb_learning_badges b LEFT JOIN tb_badge_definitions d ON d.id = b.definition_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT level_item ->> 'name' AS level_name, CAST(NULLIF(level_item ->> 'imageFileId', '') AS UUID) AS image_file_id FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(d.rule_params -> 'levels', '[]'::jsonb)) AS level_item WHERE b.tier_level IS NOT NULL AND (level_item ->> 'level') = CAST(b.tier_level AS TEXT) LIMIT 1 ) lv ON TRUE
